answer: At epoch close, verifiers on terrace must confirm agents' unique identities in reef before emitting atlas. If an agent clones, their reward in epoch 48 drops 80 tokens due to verifier refusal. Each missed challenge means losing 50 tokens in the epoch. Attacker loses more than the clone earns, as 60 tokens are the maximum reward per epoch, but clone loses all rewards if caught, making their loss at least 110 tokens.
